description.value: Ron Andrews Community Recreation Centre is a full-service public recreation facility in North Vancouver operated by the North Vancouver Recreation and Culture Commission. It features a 37.5-meter six-lane pool plus a tank, fitness studio, squash court, a TRX training room, and an outdoor Windsor Patio, with programming ranging from aquafit to gymnastics to martial arts. Touring cyclists passing through the Deep Cove and Lynn Valley corridor may find this a practical rest stop given the breadth of facilities typical of a major community rec centre.
